text:
Avery (CEO): Quick weekly check-in — thanks for a big push last sprint. A few concise priorities and a couple numbers so everyone has context.

Avery (CEO): Wins: Private EU beta finished customer onboarding (2 customers), Hosted availability 99.98% last 7d. Cost: per-1k token infra cost down ~7% vs last month. :rocket:

Avery (CEO): Priorities for next week: 1) GA checklist for Private (legal/compliance signoff + docs), 2) SLO refresh and emergency fallback validation, 3) hit -10% cost target via batching/quantization pilots. Please read the incident follow-up notes below.

Jordan (VP Product): Re: GA checklist — product will publish final docs on Monday. Rolling feature-flag for private telemetry off by default. Timeline: GA announcement targeted 03/31.

Riley (VP Eng): SLO refresh plan: change p99 latency SLO from 200ms -> 180ms for hosted small instances, with a fallback policy to medium model variant on breach. Deploying canary of fallback logic Thursday night in staging.

Riley (VP Eng): Also finished hotfix for KV cache eviction bug that partially caused last week's blip. Patch merged, monitoring dashboards updated.

Sam (SRE): Incident quick summary: root cause = race in cache refresh under burst load, triggered by a malformed client retry loop. RCA doc: https://intranet.redwood/incident/2026-03-18-cache-race (TL;DR + mitigations in doc). No customer data exposure.

Morgan (Head of Ops): Compliance note: EU customers in beta require updated DSAR workflow and KMS proof of control. Legal and security are synced; expect a runbook by Tue EOD. Also prepping audit window for next month.

Jordan (VP Product): Shipping notes: console will show new rollouts tab (canary/A-B) and a new metric for cost-per-1k. UX copy done, will ship with GA.

Taylor (Growth): Nice work. Quick ask: should we prep a short customer-facing FAQ around the fallback behavior? I can draft — want to coordinate with Product.

Avery (CEO): Yes please — Taylor, work with Jordan to draft FAQ + one-pager for account teams. Make it explicit when telemetry is off in Private.

DeployBot: canary deploy started: service/redwood-runtime v2.14 -> canary group 3 at 2026-03-19T02:10Z :white_check_mark:

Sam (SRE): Action items for SRE/Eng: 1) Confirm canary metrics by Fri EOD, 2) run synthetic burst test against canary, 3) validate rollback path.

Riley (VP Eng): Noted — synthetic burst test scheduled Friday 09:00 PT.

Morgan (Head of Ops): Ops will validate audit artifacts and KMS flow Wednesday.

Avery (CEO): Quick numbers snapshot to keep on your radar: Hosted uptime 99.98% (7d), P50 35ms / P95 120ms / P99 175ms, Infra cost per-1k tokens (moving avg) $0.42. Target: bring infra cost to ~$0.38 without impacting p95/p99.

Avery (CEO): Final ask: each lead drop a 2-line status in #eng, #product, #sales by Mon 11:00 PT covering GA blockers. Thanks team. :chart_with_upwards_trend: :handshake:
